title: AAPS After database reset: loop process blocks, app crashes on manual calculation (tab SMB/AUTOISF - swipe)
symptom: After database reset, when config is set to OpenAPS SMB or AutoISF, the loop stops and no APS/algo calculations occur on the SMB/AutoISF tab. App crashes when APS calculation is forced by manual swipe on this tab. Just before crashing, AAPS briefly shows 'Fallback to SMB. Not enough TDD data' and 'Fallback to profile sensitivity. Not enough TDD data'.
evidence_quote: Retested with todays dev-e build. Can not repro, feel free to close this issue.
